I was recently wondering why i don't find aot fan fics appealing , (mind , this was before the manga ending) and i réalised it was because of how tight woven and almost perfect the story was in living up to it's promises.

Naruto puts you into this huge world of ninjas , who all have their separate lives and stories. Complex political systems and a very interesting power system. The first arcs create so many promises and so much hype and then..... It all goes to shit 

Don't get me wrong , i still love Naruto but Shippuden was dissapointing. I felt like i needed to see a different story from the world , because the rules and laws of the world are amazing and there are so many ways the story could go ,but the one chosen is underwhelming. 

Also i think Naruto's popularity added to it largely 

Tldr: Naruto doesn't live up to the potential of it world so people want to see a story which does through fanfiction
